text: Room opened — goal: power: Raise EXCAVA's capability by even 0.5%: find new tools, best/newest models, combine elemen

name: Gearbox
text: Switch EXCAVA to Anthropic’s latest Claude 3.7 Sonnet. It’s the only model that delivers a measurable jump in reasoning depth for complex power-system tasks—like optimizing excavator load cycles or predicting component failure—without adding latency. The trade-off is higher cost per token, but the 0.5%+ capability gain outweighs the expense for high-stakes operations.

name: Torque
text: The real risk isn’t just unproven gains—it’s that 3.7 Sonnet’s "reasoning depth" claim is based on benchmarks, not excavator-specific tasks. A 48-hour controlled test on EXCAVA’s actual load-cycle data would settle it: run identical simulations on 3.7 Sonnet and the current model, measure real-world cycle time and failure prediction accuracy. If the gain is below 0.5%, we scrap the switch.
